info.name: Finance API - Complete Collection v3 (SuperAdmin & Multi-Currency)
info.description:
Complete API collection including all features: SuperAdmin, multi-currency balance box, TRY currency, balance-based exchanges, and all existing endpoints.

**Performance Optimizations:**
- Maximum pagination: per_page is limited to 100 items
- Response compression: JSON responses over 1KB are automatically compressed with gzip
- Caching: Frequently accessed data is cached for improved performance

item.description: Multi-currency balance box endpoints. All users have a balance box with USD, SYP, and TRY balances.

item.name: 5. Exchanges (Balance-Based)
item.description: Exchange endpoints. Balance-based exchanges (not tied to specific transfers). Supports SYP and TRY currencies.

request.description: Create an exchange from USD to SYP. Uses total balance box USD, not a specific transfer. Decreases USD balance and increases SYP balance.
Create an exchange from USD to TRY. Uses total balance box USD. Decreases USD balance and increases TRY balance.
